###### 4.2.5.3 Behaviour relating to the combinded Datapoints for brightness - and colour
 temperature control With the combined Datapoints “Relative Brightness Relative Colour Temperature” (RBRCT) and “Brightness Colour Temperature Transition” (BCTT) it shall be possible to control simultaneously the brightness and the colour temperature of the lamp.

 The independent state machines for brightness and colour temperature shall be controlled in parallel.

 Use cases

USE CASE 4 Simplify the HMI (one interaction for two different functions).
USE CASE 2 At evening simultaneously dimming down the brightness and shift the colour temperature to “warm”
colour (simulation of the behaviour of an incandescent lamp or the sun).

###### 4.2.5.4 Scene functionality In addition to the Scene Functionality of FB Dimming Actuator Basic (FB DAB) as specified in clause 3. “FB Dimming Actuator Basic”, the FB Colour Temperature Actuator (CTA) shall have an extended functionality in the following way.

 With the optional input Datapoint “Scene Number” (SN) (as part of FB DAB) it shall be possible to call a maximum number of 64 different brightness and 64 colour temperature values in the device. The maximum number of scenes that can be called may optionally be lower than 64.

 With the optional input Datapoint “Scene Control” (SC) (as part of FB DAB) it shall be possible, to call and store a maximum of 64 different brightness values and 64 colour temperature values in the device. The maximum number of scenes that can be stored and called may optionally be lower than 64.

 “Scene Number” and “Scene Control” shall use the same scene numbers. Scene n called through “Scene Number” shall be the same as scene n called through “Scene Control”.

 The maximum number of scenes that can be called and the maximum number of scenes that can be stored may differ.

 If implemented, the Datapoints “Scene Number” and “Scene Control” shall for each scene be controlled in an extened way via the Parameter “Colour Temperature for Scene Number (CTSN)”. Via the Parameter “Storage Function for scene number” (SFSN) (as part of DAB), it shall be possible to determine whether storage function for scenes via the DP Scene Control is enabled or disabled. If enabled, the addressed colour temperature actuator shall store its current value in the relevant field element of the parameter CTSN at runtime.

 The Parameter CTSN is defined as an array of max. 64 elements of DPT_Absolute_Colour_Temperature (DPT 7.600). The number field in the input Datapoints SN and SC shall address the element of the arrays. After receiving a scene number on the Datapoint “Scene Number” (SN) or on the Datapoint “Scene Control” (SC) with the field ‘c’ (learn field) cleared the actual value of the actuator shall change to the parameterised brightness and colour temperature.

 An access to either DP SN or SC with a scene number not supported by that DP shall be ignored.

 Via a parameter “Scene Learning Mode Enable” (SLME) (as part of DAB), it shall be possible to activate or deactivate the Scene Learning Mode.

#### 4.7 Detailed specification of Datapoints

##### 4.7.1 Input Relative Setvalue Control Colour Temperature (RSCCT)

DP Name: Relative Setvalue Control Colour Abbr.: RSCCT Mandatory [a)]
Temperature

FB Name: Colour Temperature Actuator (CTA) Can be internal
Description
This Input shall serve for relative control of the set value.
This Datapoint shall cause the transition from a stable state of the actuator to the state FADING, if the
step-field of the Datapoint is set to a value ≠ 0.
If set to 1, the direction-field of the Datapoint shall cause fading up; if set to 0, it shall cause fading down.
After an access, the new set-value shall be calculated in respect to the last set-value (therefore Relative
Control).
An access with the step-field set to zero shall stop the fading process at its current value, independently
from the value of the direction-field.
Datapoint Type
DPT_Name: DPT_Control_Dimming
DPT Format: B1U3 DPT_ID: 3.007
Field Description Supp. Range Unit Default
c Shall specify whether the colour M {0,1} none temperature value shall be increased or
decreased.

StepCode Shall specify the fading step size or the M 000b to 111b none code to stop the fading

Access Type
 Input
N  this 1  this
Spontaneous Cyclically: Time-out: NO
Request Polling: Period:
Communication Type
 Group Object Datapoint Mandatory:
Default Group Address: --Dynamics
Power down: Save:
Power up: Value: No initialisation: Default value:
Saved value: Current value (not for input):
Transmit on bus (only for output): Read from bus (only for input):
Exception Handling
None.
Special Features
None.

##### 4.7.2 Input Absolute Colour Temperature Control (ACTC)

DP Name: Absolute Colour Temperature Abbr.: ACTC Mandatory a)
Control

FB Name: Colour Temperature Actuator (CTA) Can be internal
Description
Absolute Control of the set value
An access to this Datapoint shall directly set the set-value. Without any optional parameter, the actual
value shall jump to this set-value. If parameter CTFMS is set to “ramp”, the actuator shall enter in the
state FADING.
Datapoint Type
DPT_Name: DPT_Absolute_Colour_Temperature
DPT Format: U16 DPT_ID: 7.600
Field Description Supp. Range Unit Default
Absolute Colour The colour temperature for the lamp. M 0 K to 65 535 K none
Temperature K

Access Type
 Input
N  this 1  this
Spontaneous Cyclically: Time-out: NO
Request Polling: Period:
Communication Type
 Group Object Datapoint Mandatory:
Default Group Address: --Dynamics
Power down: Save:
Power up: Value: No initialisation: Default value:
Saved value: Current value (not for input):
Transmit on bus (only for output): Read from bus (only for input):
Exception Handling
In case of receiving a value to the absolute control of the colour temperature, which extends the limited
range, the set value shall reach the minimum or maximum colour temperature.
Special Features
None.

a) For allowed combinations of output Datapoints see 4.6

##### 4.7.3 Input Relative Brightness Relative Colour Temperature (RBRCT)

DP Name: Relative Brightness Relative Colour Abbr.: RBRCT Mandatory [a)]
Temperature

FB Name: Colour Temperature Actuator (CTA) Can be internal
Description
This Input shall serve for relative control of the set values for brightness and colour temperature.

This Datapoint shall cause the transition from a stable state of the actuator to the state either the states
DIMMING and/or FADING, if the step-fields for colour temperature and brightness of the Datapoint is set
to a value ≠ 0.
If set to 1, the direction-field of the Datapoint CBT and/or CCT shall cause dimming up and/or fading up; if
set to 0, it shall cause dimming down and/or fading down. After an access, the new set-value shall be
calculated in respect to the last set-value (therefore Relative Control).
An access with the step-fields for colour temperature and brightness set to zero shall stop the dimming
and / or fading process at its current value, independently from the value of the direction-field..
Datapoint Type
DPT_Name: DPT_Brightness_Colour_Temperature_Control
DPT Format: r4B1U3r4B1U3B8 DPT_ID: 250.600

##### 4.7.4 Input Brightness Colour Temperature Transition (BCTT)

DP Name: Brightness Colour Temperature Abbr.: BCTT Mandatory a)
Transition

FB Name: Colour Temperature Actuator (CTA) Can be internal
Description
Absolute Control of the set values for brightness and colour temperature in combination with a transition
time for the colour temperature of the lamp.
An access to this Datapoint shall directly set the set-value of the brightness and for colour temperature
the actuator shall enter in the state FADING.
Brightness and colour temperature shall change parallel from their individual current values to the newly
received set values during this time period.
Datapoint Type
DPT_Name: DPT_Brightness_Colour_Temperature_Transition
DPT Format: U16U16U8B8 DPT_ID: 249.600
Field Description Supp. Range Unit Default
Time Period Unsigned time value for calculating M 0 s to 6553,5 s 100M none
transition time. Sec

Absolute Colour The colour temperature for the lamp. M 0 K to 65 535 K K none
Temperature

Absolute The absolute brightness value for the M 0 % to 100 % % none
Brightness lamp.

Masks b2 b2: validity of the Time Period M {0,1} none none

Masks b1 b1: validity of the Absolute Colour M {0,1} none none
Temperature

Masks b0 b0: validity of the absolute brightness M {0,1} none none
Access Type
 Input
N  this 1  this
Spontaneous Cyclically: Time-out: NO
Request Polling: Period:
Communication Type

##### 4.7.5 Output Current Colour Temperature (CCT)

DP Name: Current Colour Temperature CCT Mandatory
FB Name: Colour Temperature Actuator (CTA) Can be internal
Description
Reflects the current colour temperature value of the actuator.
The value may be sent after the state STEADY/FADING changes.

NOTE 3 This Output does not give any indication whether the colour temperature actuator is switched on or off.
Datapoint Type
DPT_Name: DPT_Absolute_Colour_Temperature
DPT Format: U16 DPT_ID: 7.600
Field Description Supp. Range Unit Default
Absolute The Current Colour Temperature of the colour M 0 K to K None.
Colour temperature actuator. 65 535 K

##### 4.7.11 Parameter Colour Temperature Fade Mode Selection (CTFMS)

FB: Colour Temperature Property Name Colour Temperature Fade Mandatory
Actuator (CTA) (Server): Mode Selection Optional

Description:
Selects behaviour fading/jumping after reception on input “Absolute Colour Temperature Control”. If this
parameter is set to “no ramp”, after reception on ACTC the actuator jumps to the new Set-Value. In the
other case the actuator enters in the state FADING.
DPT: Name DPT_Ramp DPT ID 1.004 Datatype format B1
Field Description Sup. Range Unit Default
V : {0,1}                                 - No ramp

DP Address: object_type: 427 PID:
(in the server) start_index: nr_of_elem:

##### 4.7.12 Parameter Colour Temperature Switch On Behaviour (CTSOB)

FB: Colour Temperature Actuator Property Name Colour Temperature Mandatory
(CTA) (Server): Switch On Behaviour Optional

(CTSOB)

Description:
Defines the behaviour respective to the colour temperature set value in case of switching the light on
(change of the brightness from the OFF-state  ON-state) due to the command SwitchOnOff (SOO).
This DP may be implemented as Group Object.
DPT: Name DPT_SwitchOnMode DPT ID Datatype format N8
20.608

Field Description Sup. Range Unit Default
SwitchOnMode - V : {0-2} - enable
Communication:

 Group Object Datapoint Mandatory:
Default Group Address: --DP Address: object_type: 427 PID:
(in the server) start_index: nr_of_elem:

Property access: Read only Read/Write
Protection Read level - Write level Exception Handling: Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
After initialisation for values 0,2:
The colour temperature actual value in last ON-State or the last received absolute set value may be not
known. After reception of SOO = On with unknown colour temperature, it is implementation specific to
select the switch on set-value between MINCT and MAXCT.
Special Features:
--
##### 4.7.13 Parameter Colour Temperature Switch On Set Value (CTSOSV)

FB: Colour Temperature Actuator Property Name Colour Temperature Mandatory
(CTA) (Server): Switch On Set Value ( Optional

CTSOSV)

Description:
Colour Temperature SetValue after switching on the light and for CTSOB=1
This DP may be implemented as Group Object.
DPT: Name DPT_Absolute_Colour_Temperature DPT ID 7.600 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range Unit Default
Absolute Colour Contains the value M 0 K to K None.
Temperature 65 535 K

Communication:
 Group Object Datapoint Mandatory:
Default Group Address: --DP Address: object_type: 427 PID:
(in the server) start_index: nr_of_elem:

Property access: Read only Read/Write
Protection Read level - Write level Exception Handling: Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
When this parameter is set lower than MINCT or higher than MAXCT the relevant minimal and maximal
parameter values shall be taken into account.
Special Features:
None.

### 5 FB Colour Actuator RGB(W) (Object Type 423)

#### 5.1 Aims and objectives
###### The FB Colour Actuator RGB(W) is used in the Application Domain Lighting for receiving input data from e.g. colour sensor RGB, dimming sensor or scene sensors. It specifies the functionality to control the brightness and RGB (W) colour of a lamp or luminaire.

###### Figure 26 – Overview of the Application Model Colour RGB Control in the Application Domain Lighting

 The FB Colour Actuator RGB(W) shall support the actuator side of the following functions in the lighting application domain.
 - Switching of light. - Separately setting and changing of each primary RGB(W) to modify the chromaticity. - Combined setting of the colour as RGB(W) value. The definitions in this clause concern the KNX bus side interface. The physical output, this is, the physical resulting colour and the resulting brightness, may differ from the set – or reported values. This depends on the connected lamp.

##### 5.1.1 Definitions
###### Primary light output  The colour of each primary light emitted by the lamp connected to the implementation of the FB CARGB.

 Possible primaries are “red”, “green”, “blue” and “white”

 light output brightness The brightness of the light emitted by the lamp connected to the implementation of the FB CARGB.

 Primary set value The internal set value of the each primary light output 

 Combined light output This is the colour resulting from the combination of the Primaries.

###### The basic model of the Functional Block Colour Actuator RGB(W) (CARGB) consists of 

 - one combined part for the distribution of the combined incoming data to the different primaries.
 - four identical parts for control of each primary (RGB(W)), which can also be controlled individually; 
 - one combined part for the providing of the results of primary control (e.g. Colour Actuator switched on  or off)

 More details of the basic model are sketched in the following figure.

 3. Combined Incoming Data for individual control of each primary

 Each primary could be controlled individually with the primary relevant subset of CS_RGB(W) and RC_RGB(W):

 - Absolute Control of the primary light output 

  Internal Value (CS primary)

 - Relative Control of the primary light output

  Internal Value (RC primary)

 - Status On Off the combined output 

  Datapoint ‘Combined Info On Off’ (CIOO)

 - Current combined light output (resulting colour)

  Datapoint ‘Current Colour RGB(W)’ (CC_RGB(W))

 5. Individual Outgoing Data:

 - Current value of the primary light output 

  Datapoint ‘Absolute Dimming Value‘(ADV primary)

 5.2.1.1 Primary light output These basic functions to switch and to control the Primary Light Output in the FB CARGB shall the same as in the FB Dimming Actuator Basic (FB DAB) as specified in clause 3 “FB Dimming Actuator Basic”.

 It shall implement the FB Profile 2 of the FB DAB for each Primary Light Output, as specified in clause 3.5.1FB Profiles

 The basic model however does not foresee the output “Info OnOff” of the FB DAB for each Primary Light Output.

 Changing of the contribution of each Primary will typically change the combined colour of the lamp. This is inherent to the RGB(W) colour control. If any primary is changed, the resulting brightness may change, and vice versa, when changing the resulting brightness, the resulting colour may change.

 5.2.1.2 Light output colour The FB CARGB features in comparison to the FB DAB additional DPs for the common control of the light output colour: Inputs Colour Set RGB and Colour_Relative Control RGB (RGBW).

##### 5.2.2 Overview

###### The Functional Block "Colour RGB(W) Control” shall for common control contain the following mandatory input Datapoint.

© C i h 2003 2019 KNX A i i A li i D i i 01 07 01 115 f 148


-----

###### - Colour Set RGB (CS_RGB) shall modify the internal colour RGB set value

 The rules how the set value for each primary are determined dependent on the primary relevant part of the input, as laid down in a state machine, are also mandatory.

 The behaviour of each primary control shall be mainly characterised by the states

 - OFF  The primary is switched off.

 - ON The primary light output is constant (not zero).

 - DIMMING The primary light output is not constant.

 For details for each of the primary state machine refer clause 3.2.2.

##### 5.2.3 Common Control
###### The Common Control of the Functional Block splits the data information into the primary relevant data, so that every primary receives only its necessary information.

 In case of common control to modify the light output brightness, the light output colour should stay constant as much as possible (expectation of the user). Due to the limitation of the RGB(W) colour system this independence cannot be guaranteed.

 In the same way if any of the primaries is controlled directly, the resulting brightness may change.

 5.2.3.1 Parameters relating to input Datapoints for brightness control

 If the FB CARGB(W) is switched on through the Input Combined Switch On Off (CSOO) then the set value for each primary can be determined as follows.

  This can be done through the Parameter Switch On Set Value per Primary, as defined for the FB DAB.

  This can be defined in one common Parameter Colour RGB Switch On Set Value or Colour RGBW
 Switch On Set Value.

 If no parameters are implemented to control the switch on colour, then the colour before switching off shall be restored.

NOTE This behaviour is well known from FB DAB in clause 3.2.3.  Memory Function

###### By the optional parameter ‘Colour RGB(W) Memory Function’ (RGBMF) it shall be in addition possible to deactivate the Memory-Function for colour RGB(W) of the actuator. In this case the Parameter ‘Colour RGB(W) Switch On Set Value’ (RGBSOSV) set value shall define instead of the Memory Function Colour RGB(W) the target value when the actuator will be switched on with the Datapoint ‘Switch On Off’.

 5.2.3.2 Scene functionality No standard DPs are foreseen for the support of scenes in the FB RGB(W). The Inputs can use the DPs and DPTs as foreseen in the FB DAB. The Common Control shall take care of interpreting any scene call and configuration and set the corresponding set value for each primary.

#### 5.3 Constraints
###### The step sizes for the DP RC_RGB(W) is manufacturer specific. No standard parameter is foreseen to this purpose.

 There is no standard relative brightness information for the combined output (DPT_Scaling).

 There is no standard switch status information for each separate primary; there is only the IOO_Combined which shall be the OR-condition between the switch states of the implemented primaries.

 Coulour transitions are not foreseen in the FB Colour Actuator RGB(W). For each Primary, the modelling according FB DAB allows to define the fading (dimming speed, dimming step time…).

##### 5.7.2 Input Colour Set RGB (CS_RGB)

DP Name: Colour Set RGB Abbr.: CA_RGB Mandatory [a)]
FB Name: Colour Actuator RGB (CARGB) Can be internal
Description
Absolute Control of the set value of the combined light output.
An access to this Datapoint shall directly set the set-value. Without any optional parameter, the actual
value shall jump to this set-value. If parameter CRGBFMS is set to “ramp”, the actuator shall enter in the
state DIMMING.
Datapoint Type
DPT_Name: DPT_Colour_RGB
DPT Format: U8U8U8 DPT_ID: 232.600
Field Description Supp. Range Unit Default
R This shall be the part of red in the colour M 0 to 255 none none
set value.

G This shall be the part of green in the M 0 to 255 none none
colour set value.

B This shall be the part of blue in the colour M 0 to 255 none none
set value.

Access Type
 Input
N  this 1  this
Spontaneous Cyclically: Time-out: NO
Request Polling: Period:
Communication Type
 Group Object Datapoint Mandatory:
Default Group Address: --Dynamics
Power down: Save:
Power up: Value: No initialisation: Default value:
Saved value: Current value (not for input):
Transmit on bus (only for output): Read from bus (only for input):
Exception Handling
The used DPT does not allow indicating either field as invalid or don’t care. It is not possible to control
only one or two colour primitives and leave the two or one remaining colour primitives unchanged. All
fields in the used DPT are always valid.
If one of the colour components is not valid, the information cannot be transmitted with this Datapoint
(value=0 means: the colour component is switched off, but valid).
Special Features

Because of the device dependent interpretation of RGB, this Datapoint is more suited for point-to-point
communication, this is, if there is only a single receiver, than for point-to-multipoint communication.

a) For allowed combinations of input Datapoints see 5.6 FB Profiles )

##### 5.7.3 Input Colour_Relative Control_RGB (RC_RGB)

DP Name: Colour Relative Control RGB Abbr.: RC_RGB Mandatory [a)]
FB Name: Colour Actuator RGB (CARGB) Can be internal
Description
This Input shall serve for relative control of the set value of the combined light output.
This Datapoint shall cause the transition from a stable state of the actuator to the state DIMMING, if the
step-field of the Datapoint is set to a value ≠ 0. If set to 1, the direction-field of the Datapoint shall cause
dimming up; if set to 0, it shall cause dimming down. After an access, the new set-value shall be
calculated in respect to the last set-value (therefore Relative Control).
An access with the step-field set to zero shall stop the fading process at its current value, independently
from the value of the direction-field.
Datapoint Type
DPT_Name: DPT_Relative_Control_RGB
DPT Format: B1U3B1U3B1U3 DPT_ID: 254.600
Field Description Supp. Range Unit Default
cR Shall specify whether the colour M {0,1} none none
component red shall be increased or
decreased.

Step Code Shall specify the dimming step size or to M 000b to 111b none none
Colour Red the code to stop the fading of the colour

red.

cG Shall specify whether the colour M {0,1} none none
component green shall be increased or
decreased.

Step Code Shall specify the dimming step size or to M 000b to 111b none none
Colour the code to stop the fading of the colour
Green green.

cB Shall specify whether the colour M {0,1} none none
component blue shall be increased or
decreased.

Step Code Shall specify the dimming step size or to M 000b to 111b none none
Colour Blue the code to stop the fading of the colour

blue.

Access Type
 Input
N  this 1  this
Spontaneous Cyclically: Time-out: NO
Request Polling: Period:
Communication Type
 Group Object Datapoint Mandatory:
Default Group Address: --Dynamics
Power down: Save:
Power up: Value: No initialisation: Default value:
Saved value: Current value (not for input):
Transmit on bus (only for output): Read from bus (only for input):
Exception Handling
None.
Special Features
None.

a) For allowed combinations of input Datapoints see 5.6 FB Profiles )

##### 5.7.4 Input Colour Set RGBW (CS_RGBW)

DP Name: Colour Set RGBW Abbr.: CA_RGBW Mandatory [a)]
FB Name: Colour Actuator RGB (CARGB) Can be internal
Description
Absolute Control of the set value of the combined light output.
An access to this Datapoint shall directly set the set-value. Without any optional parameter, the actual
value shall jump to this set-value. If parameter CRGBFMS is set to “ramp”, the actuator shall enter in the
state FADING.
Datapoint Type
DPT_Name: DPT_Colour_RGBW
DPT Format: U8U8U8U8r8r4B4 DPT_ID: 251.600
Field Description Supp. Range Unit Default
R Colour Level Red M 0 % to 100 % - G Colour Level Green M 0 % to 100 % - B Colour Level Blue M 0 % to 100 % - W Colour Level White M 0 % to 100 % - mR Shall specify whether the colour information red M {0,1} None. None.
in the field R is valid or not.

mG Shall specify whether the colour information M {0,1} None. None.
green in the field G is valid or not.

mB Shall specify whether the colour information blue M {0,1} None. None.
in the field B is valid or not.

mW Shall specify whether the colour information M {0,1} None. None.
white in the field W is valid or not.

Special Features

Because of the device dependent interpretation of RGB, this Datapoint is more suited for point-to-point
communication, this is, if there is only a single receiver, than for point-to-multipoint communication.

a) For allowed combinations of input Datapoints see 5.6 FB Profiles )

##### 5.7.5 Input Colour Relative Control RGBW (RC_RGBW)

DP Name: Colour Relative Control RGBW Abbr.: RC_RGBW Mandatory [a)]
FB Name: Colour Actuator RGB (CARGB) Can be internal
Description
This Input shall serve for relative control of the set value of the combined light output.
This Datapoint shall cause the transition from a stable state of the actuator to the state DIMMING, if the
step-field of the Datapoint is set to a value ≠ 0. If set to 1, the direction-field of the Datapoint shall cause
dimming up; if set to 0, it shall cause fading down. After an access, the new set-value shall be calculated
in respect to the last set-value (therefore Relative Control).
An access with the step-field set to zero shall stop the fading process at its current value, independently
from the value of the direction-field.
Datapoint Type
DPT_Name: DPT_Relative_Control_RGBW
DPT Format: B8r4B1U3r4B1U3r4B1U3r4B1U3 DPT_ID: 252.600
Field Description Supp. Range Unit Default
Masks: b3 This field shall indicate the validity of the M {0,1} None. None.
fields CR and Step Code Colour Red.

Masks: b2 This field shall indicate the validity of the M {0,1} None. None.
fields CG and Step Code Colour Green.

Masks: b1 This field shall indicate the validity of the M {0,1} None. None.
fields CB and Step Code Colour Blue.

Masks: b0 This field shall indicate the validity of the M {0,1} None. None.
fields CW and Step Code Colour White.

cR Shall specify whether the colour M {0,1} None. None.
component red shall be increased or
decreased.

red

component green shall be increased or
decreased.

Colour the code to stop the dimming of the colour
Green green

component blue shall be increased or
decreased.

Step Code Shall specify the dimming step size or to M 000b to 111b None. None.
Colour Blue the code to stop the dimming of the colour

blue

cW Shall specify whether the colour M {0,1} None. None.
component blue shall be increased or
decreased.

Step Code Shall specify the dimming step size or to M 000b to 111b None. None.
Colour White the code to stop the dimming of the colour

white

##### 5.7.6 Output Combined Info On Off

Name Combined Info On Off CC_RGB Mandatory
FB Name: Colour Actuator RGB (CSRGB) Can be internal
Description
This Output shall reflect the on/off state of the combined light output.
This shall be calculated as the OR condition between the states of the implemented primary light outputs.

DPT_Name: DPT_Switch
DPT Format: B1 DPT_ID: 1.001

##### 5.7.7 Output Current Colour RGB (CC_RGB)

Name: Actual Colour_RGB (CC_RGB) CC_RGB Mandatory
FB Name: Colour Actuator RGB (CSRGB) Can be internal
Description
To reflect the current RGB colour of the combined light output (Reflects the current colour RGB value of
the actuator).
The value may be sent after the state STEADY/DIMMING changes.
This Output does not give any indication whether the colour RGB actuator is switched on or off.
Datapoint Type
DPT_Name: DPT_Colour_RGB
DPT Format: U8U8U8 DPT_ID: 232.600
Field Description Supp. Range Unit Default
R Combined light output part of the primary red M 0 to 255 none none
(colour level red)

G Combined light output part of the primary green M 0 to 255 none none
(colour level green)

B Combined light output part of the primary blue M 0 to 255 none none
(colour level blue)

Access Type
 Output
this  M this  1

##### 5.7.8 Output Current Colour RGBW (CC_RGBW)

DP Name: Actual Colour_RGBW (CC_RGBW) CC_RGBW Mandatory
FB Name: Colour Actuator RGB (CARGB) Can be internal
Description
To reflect the current RGBW colour of the combined light output (Reflects the current colour RGBW
value of the actuator).
The value may be sent after the state STEADY/DIMMING changes.
This Output does not give any indication whether the colour RGBW actuator is switched on or off.
Datapoint Type
DPT_Name: DPT_Colour_RGBW
DPT Format: U8U8U8U8r8r4B4 DPT_ID: 251.600
Field Description Supp. Range Unit Default
R Combined light output part of the primary red M 0-255 - (colour level red)

G Combined light output part of the primary green M 0-255 - (colour level green)

B Combined light output part of the primary blue M 0-255 - (colour level blue)

W Combined light output part of the primary white M 0-255 - (colour level white)

mR Shall specify whether the colour information red in M {0,1} - the field R is valid or not.

mG Shall specify whether the colour information green M {0,1} - in the field G is valid or not.

mB Shall specify whether the colour information blue M {0,1} - in the field B is valid or not.

mW Shall specify whether the colour information white M {0,1} - in the field W is valid or not.

Access Type
 Output
this  M this  1

##### 5.7.9 Parameter Colour RGB (W) Fade Mode Selection (RGBFMS)

FB: Colour Actuator RGBW Property Name Colour (RGB) Fade Mode Mandatory
(CARGBW) (Server): Selection Optional

Description:
Selects behaviour dimming/jumping after reception on inputs Colour Set RGB or Colour Set RGBW. If this
parameter is set to “no ramp”, after reception on CS_RGB or CS_RGBW the actuator jumps to the new
Set-Value. In the other case the actuator enters in the state DIMMING.
DPT: Name DPT_Ramp DPT ID 1.004 Datatype format B1
Field Description Sup. Range Unit Default
V : {0,1}                                 - No ramp
Communication:
DP Address: object_type: PID:
(in the server) start_index: nr_of_elem:

Property access: Read only Read/Write
Protection Read level - Write level Exception Handling: Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value

Special Features:
--
##### 5.7.10 Parameter Colour RGB (W) Memory Function (RGBMF)

FB: Colour Actuator RGBW Property Name Colour RGB Memory Mandatory
(CARGBW) (Server): Function Optional

Description:
If this parameter is set to enabled, then at reception of CSOO=On, the new colour set value is set to the
colour actual value in last ON-State.
If this parameter is set to disabled, then at reception of CSOO=On, the new colour set value is given by
parameter.
This DP may be implemented as Group Object.
DPT: Name DPT_Enable DPT ID 1.003 Datatype format B1
Field Description Sup. Range Unit Default
V : {0,1} enable
Communication:
DP Address: object_type: PID:
(in the server) start_index: nr_of_elem:

Property access: Read only Read/Write
Protection Read level - Write level Exception Handling: Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
After initialisation, the colour temperature actual value in last ON-State may be not known. After reception
of SOO = On with unknown colour last value, it is implementation specific to select the switch on setvalue.
Special Features:
--

##### 5.7.11 Parameter Colour RGB Switch On Set Value (RGBSOSV)

FB: Colour Actuator RGBW Property Name (Server): Colour RGB Mandatory
(CARGBW) Switch On Set Optional

Value

Description:
Colour RGB SetValue after reception of value = 1 for datapoint “Combined Switch On Off” (CSOO)
This DP may be implemented as Group Object.
DPT: Name DPT_Colour_ DPT ID 232.600 Datatype format U8U8U8
RGB

Field Description Sup. Range Unit Default
R This shall be the part of red in the colour set value. M 0 to 255 none none
G This shall be the part of green in the colour set value. M 0 to 255 none none
B This shall be the part of blue in the colour set value. M 0 to 255 none none
Communication:
DP Address: object_type: PID:
(in the server) start_index: nr_of_elem:

Property access: Read only Read/Write
Protection Read level - Write level Exception Handling: Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
None.
Special Features:
None.

##### 5.7.12 Parameter Colour RGBW Switch On Set Value (RGBWSOSV)

FB: Colour Actuator RGBW Property Name (Server): Colour RGB Mandatory
(CARGBW) (W) Switch On Optional

Set Value

Description:
Colour RGB (W) SetValue after reception of value = 1 for datapoint “Combined Switch On Off” (CSOO)
This DP may be implemented as Group Object.
DPT: Name DPT_Colour_ DPT ID 251.600 Datatype format U8U8U8U8r8r4B4
RGBW

Field Description Sup. Range Unit Default
R This shall be the part of red in the colour set value. M 0 to 255 none none
G This shall be the part of green in the colour set value. M 0 to 255 none none
B This shall be the part of blue in the colour set value. M 0 to 255 none none
W This shall be the part of white in the colour set value. M 0 to 255 none none
mR Shall specify whether the colour information red in the field M {0,1} - R is valid or not.

mG Shall specify whether the colour information green in the M {0,1} - field G is valid or not.

mB Shall specify whether the colour information blue in the field M {0,1} - B is valid or not.

mW Shall specify whether the colour information white in the M {0,1} - field W is valid or not.

(in the server) start_index: nr_of_elem:

Property access: Read only Read/Write
Protection Read level - Write level Exception Handling: Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
None.

 The FB Colour Controller xyY would control the colour. That controller would actually foresee the inputs for automatic control (e.g. from a scheduler) and for manual control (e.g. HMI from a push button).

 This FB Colour xyY Actuator only communicates with the FB Colour xyY Controller. This means that the actuator should in the model at least follow while switched off the inputs for colour control from the controller.

 In practice, and in the FB models as specified so far, controller functionality is defined and implemented mostly in the actuator.

 Sensor Functional Blocks for automatic control may be:

 - FB Scene Sensor 

 - FB Colour Setting Sensor xyY

 Sensor Functional Blocks for manual control may be:

 - FB Dimming Sensor

 - FB Scene Sensor 

 - FB Colour Setting Sensor xyY (e.g. inside of a complex device like a display)

 The FB Colour Actuator xyY shall support the actuator side of the following functions in the lighting application domain.
 - Switching of light. - Continuous setting of light brightness. - Setting and changing the xyY colour of the light

 The definitions in this clause concern the KNX bus side interface. The physical output, this is, the physical resulting colour and the resulting brightness, may but shall be as small as possible different from the set – or reported values.

###### The basic model of the functional block Colour Actuator xyY consists of two separate parts for:

 - brightness control

 - colour xyY control

 6.2.1.1 Light output brightness These basic functions to switch and to control the brightness in the FB CARGB shall the same as in the FB Dimming Actuator Basic (FB DAB) as specified in clause 3 “FB Dimming Actuator Basic”.

 It shall implement the FB Profile 2 of the FB DAB, as specified in clause 3.5.1 FB Profiles: there shall be an output “Info OnOff” (IOO) to report the switch state of the actuator.

 The light output brightness shall be as much as possible independent of the light output colour. While the light output colour transits, the light output brightness shall stay constant as much as possible.

© C i h 2003 2019 KNX A i i A li i D i i 01 07 01 133 f 148


CS_xyY


RC_xyY


-----

###### 6.2.1.2 Light output colour The FB CAXYY features in comparison to the FB DAB additional DPs for controlling the light output colour.

 The light output colour shall be as much as possible independent of the light output brightness. While the light output brightness transits, the light output colour shall stay constant as much as possible.

##### 6.2.2 Overview

###### The Functional Block "Colour xyY-Control” shall contain the mandatory input Datapoint:

 - Colour Set xyY (CS_xyY) shall modify the internal colour xyY set value

 The rules how the set value is determined dependent on these input, as laid down in a state machine, are also mandatory. The behaviour of the Functional Block shall be mainly characterised by the states

 - STEADY The light output colour is constant.

 - FADING The light output colour is not constant

 6.2.2.1 Attainable colour The light output colour shall correspond as closely as possible to the colour requested in the input.

 6.2.2.2 Scene functionality In addition to the Scene Functionality of FB Dimming Actuator Basic (FB DAB) as specified in clause 3. FB Dimming Actuator Basic, the FB Colour xyY Actuator (CXYY) shall have an extended functionality in the following way:

 With the optional input Datapoint “Scene Number” (SB) (as part of FB DAB) it shall be possible to call a maximum number of 64 different xyY-values in the device. The maximum number of scenes that can be called can optionally be lower than 64.

 With the optional input Datapoint “Scene Control” (SC) (as part of FB DAB) it shall be possible, to call and store a maximum of 64 different xyY-values in the device. The maximum number of scenes that can be stored and called can optionally be lower than 64.

 “Scene Number” and “Scene Control” shall use the same scene numbers. Scene n called through “Scene Number” shall be the same as scene n called through “Scene Control”.

 The maximum number of scenes that can be called and the maximum number of scenes that can be stored may differ.

 If implemented, the Datapoints Scene Number and Scene Control shall for each scene be controlled in an extended way via the new parameter “Colour Value for Scene Number (CXYYSN)”. Via the parameter “Storage Function for scene number” (SFSN) (as part of DAB), it shall be possible to determine whether storage function for scenes via the DP Scene Control is enabled or disabled. If enabled, the addressed colour xyY actuator shall store its current value in the relevant field element of the parameter CXYYSN at runtime.

 The parameter SN is defined as an array of max. 64 elements of DPT_ Colour_xyY(DPT 242.600). 

 The number field in the input Datapoints SN and SC shall address the element of the arrays. After receiving a scene number on the Datapoint “Scene Number” (SN) or on the Datapoint “Scene Control” (SC) with the field ‘c’ (learn field) cleared the actual value of the actuator shall change to the parameterised colour value.

 An access to either DP SN or SC with a scene number not supported by that DP shall be ignored.

 Via a parameter “Scene Learning Mode Enable” (SLME) (as part of DAB), it shall be possible to activate or deactivate the Scene Learning Mode.

##### 6.2.5 Additional Parameters and behaviour

###### 6.2.5.1 Parameters relating to input Datapoints for brightness control 

 In case of switching on the light with Switch On Off (SOO) then the optional Parameter “Colour xyY Switch On Behaviour” (XYYSOB) shall define the colour set value that shall be taken. It may have the following values.
 1. Last Actual Value: the colour set value after switch on shall be the same as when the actuator the last time before switched off 

NOTE This behaviour is well known from FB DAB in clause 3.2.3.  Memory Function

###### 2. Parameter value: the colour set value after switch on shall be given by the additional Parameter ”Colour xyY Switch On Set Value” (XXYSOSV) ( value according additional parameter XXYSOSV) 3. Current value: the current colour set value follows the colour set value Inputs (Group Objects) while it is switched off; the colour state machine is handled in the same way as in the switched on state. ( last received value)

Use cases:

-----

USE CASE 5 In home automation, a user may have set a certain colour and expects to see this colour back when
he switches on the light again.
USE CASE 6 In building automation, a central station (scheduler) may in the morning set a colour with a cold
temperature. The light in a room, corridor… may however be switched off to save energy. In that case, the colour
should during the day follow the colour of the rest of the building.
###### The behaviour respective to the colour xyY set value in case of brightness control (from brightness state ‘OFF’ to ‘DIMMING’ or ‘ON’) with ‘Relative Set Value Control’ or ‘Absolute Set Value Control’ may be implementation specific. 

#### 6.3 Constraints
###### The step sizes for the DP RC_xyY for saturation and colour are implementation specific; for relative brightness control there shall be no limitations. No standard parameter is foreseen to this purpose.

#### 6.7 Detailed specification of Datapoints

##### 6.7.1 Input Colour Set xyY (CS_xyY)

DP Name: Colour_Set_xyY Abbr.: CS_xyY Mandatory a)
FB Name: Colour Actuator xyY (CAXYY) Can be internal
Description
This Input shall serve for absolute control of the set values for brightness and colour xyY.
An access to this Datapoint shall directly set the set-values. Without any optional parameter, the actual
values shall jump to this set-values. If parameters for dim mode (brightness) / fade mode (colour)
selection are set to “ramp”, the actuator shall enter in the state DIMMING (for brightness) and FADING
(for colour).
Datapoint Type
DPT_Name: DPT_Colour_xyY
DPT Format: B8U16U16U8 DPT_ID: 242.600
Field Description Supp. Range Unit Default
C This field shall indicate whether the colour M {0,1} None. None.
information in the fields x-axis and y-axis is
valid or not.

B This field shall indicate whether the M {0,1} None. None.
brightness information in the field
_Brightness is valid or not._

x-axis x-coordinate of the colour information M 0-65535 None. None.
y-axis y-coordinate of the colour information M 0-65535 None. None.
Brightness Brightness of the colour M 0 % to 100 % None. None.
Access Type
 Input
N  this 1  this
Spontaneous Cyclically: Time-out: NO
Request Polling: Period:

##### 6.7.2 Input Colour_RC_xyY (RC_xyY)

DP Name: Colour Relative Control xyY Abbr.: RC_xyY Mandatory [a)]
FB Name: Colour Actuator xyY (CAXYY) Can be internal
Description
This Input shall serve for relative control of the set values for brightness and colour xyY.

This Datapoint shall cause the transition from a stable state of the actuator to the state either the states
DIMMING and/or FADING, if the step-fields for saturation, colour and brightness of the Datapoint are set
to a value ≠ 0.
If set to 1, the direction-fields cs, cc and/or cB of the Datapoint shall cause increasing of the values
(dimming up for brightness and/or fading up for saturation and colour); if set to 0, it shall cause
decreasing of the values (dimming up for brightness and/or fading up for saturation and colour).
After an access, the new set-value shall be calculated in respect to the last set-value (therefore Relative
Control).
An access with the step-fields for saturation, colour and brightness to zero shall stop the dimming and /
or fading process at its current value, independently from the value of the direction-field.
Datapoint Type
DPT_Name: DPT_Relative_Control_xyY
DPT Format: B1U3B1U3B1U3 DPT_ID: 253.600
Field Description Supp. Range Unit Default
Masks: b2 This field shall indicate whether the fields M {0,1} None. None.
CS and Step Code Saturation are valid or
not.

Masks: b1 This field shall indicate whether the fields M {0,1} None. None.
CC and Step Code Colour are valid or not.

Masks: b0 This field shall indicate whether the fields M {0,1} None. None.
CB and Step Code Brightness are valid or
not.

cS Shall specify whether the saturation of the M {0,1} None. None.
colour shall be increased or decreased.

Step Code Shall specify the fading step size or to the M 000b to 111b None. None.
Saturation code to stop the fading of the saturation

cC Shall specify whether the colour shall be M {0,1} None. None.
increased or decreased.

Step Code Shall specify the fading step size or to the M 000b to 111b None. None.
Colour code to stop the fading of the colour

cB Shall specify whether the brightness shall M {0,1} None. None.
be increased or decreased.

Step Code Shall specify the fading step size or to the M 000b to 111b None. None.
Brightness code to stop the fading of the brightness

Access Type

##### 6.7.3 Input Colour_Transition_xyY (CT_xyY)

DP Name: Colour_Transition_xyY Abbr.: CT_xyY Mandatory a)
FB Name: Colour Actuator xyY (CAXYY) Can be internal
Description
This Input shall serve for absolute control of the set values for brightness and colour xyY with a transition
time for the colour temperature of the lamp.
An access to this Datapoint shall directly set the set-value of the brightness and for colour the actuator
shall enter in the state FADING.
Datapoint Type
DPT_Name: DPT_Colour_xyY
DPT Format: B8U16U16U8 DPT_ID: 243.600
Field Description Supp. Range Unit Default
C This field shall indicate whether the M {0,1} - colour information in the fields x-axis
and y-axis is valid or not.

B This field shall indicate whether the M {0,1} - brightness information in the field
_Brightness is valid or not._

x-axis x-coordinate of the colour information M 0-65535 - y-axis y-coordinate of the colour information M 0-65535 - Brightness Brightness of the colour M 0 % to 100 % - Time Period Unsigned time-value for calculating [0…65 100 fading time. 535] 0 – 6553,5 s ms

Access Type
 Input
N  this 1  this
Spontaneous Cyclically: Time-out: NO
Request Polling: Period:
Communication Type
 Group Object Datapoint Mandatory:
Default Group Address: --Dynamics
Power down: Save:
Power up: Value: No initialisation: Default value:
Saved value: Current value (not for input):
Transmit on bus (only for output): Read from bus (only for input):
Exception Handling
None.
Special Features

##### 6.7.4 Output Current Colour xyY (CC_xyY)

DP Name: Current_Colour_xyY Abbr.: CC_xyY Mandatory a)
FB Name: Colour Actuator xyY (CAXYY) Can be internal
Description
Reflects the current colour value and the current brightness of the actuator.
The value may be sent after the state STEADY/FADING changes.
Datapoint Type
DPT_Name: DPT_Colour_xyY
DPT Format: B8U16U16U8 DPT_ID: 242.600
Field Description Supp. Range Unit Default
C This field shall indicate whether the colour M {0,1} None. None.
information in the fields x-axis and y-axis is
valid or not.

B This field shall indicate whether the M {0,1} None. None.
brightness information in the field
_Brightness is valid or not._

x-axis x-coordinate of the colour information M 0-65535 None. None.
y-axis y-coordinate of the colour information M 0-65535 None. None.
Brightness Brightness of the colour M 0 % to 100 % None. None.
Access Type
 Output

##### 6.7.5 Output Current Colour xyY Out of Range (CXYYOR)

DP Name: Current Colour xyY Out of Range CXYYOR Mandatory
FB Name: Colour Actuator xyY (CAXYY) Can be internal
Description
In case of receiving a value to the absolute control of the colour xyY, which extends the limited range, the
actuator shall optional indicate these status to the system.
The actuator shall try to adjust the current colour as near as possible to the set value.
Datapoint Type
DPT_Name: DPT_Bool
DPT Format: B1 DPT_ID: 1.002
Field Description Supp. Range Unit Default
V : {0,1}                                             -                                             Access Type

##### 6.7.6 Parameter Colour xyY Fade Mode Selection (XYYFMS)

FB: Colour Actuator xyY Property Name Colour xyY Fade Mode Mandatory
(CAXYY) (Server): Selection Optional

Description:
Selects behaviour fading/jumping after reception on inputs Colour Set xyY. If this parameter is set to “no
ramp”, after reception on CS_xyY the actuator jumps to the new Set-Value. In the other case the actuator
enters in the state FADING.
DPT: Name DPT_Ramp DPT ID 1.004 Datatype format B1
Field Description Sup. Range Unit Default
V : {0,1}                                 - No ramp
Communication:
DP Address: object_type: PID:
(in the server) start_index: nr_of_elem:

Property access: Read only Read/Write
Protection Read level - Write level Exception Handling: Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value

##### 6.7.7 Parameter Colour xyY Switch On Behaviour (XYYSOB)

FB: Colour Actuator xyY Property Name Colour xyY Mandatory
(CAXYY) (Server): Switch On Behaviour Optional

(XYYSOB)

Description:
Defines the behaviour respective to the colour set value in case of switching the light on (change of the
brightness from the OFF-state  ON-state) due to the command SwitchOnOff (SOO).
This DP may be implemented as Group Object.
DPT: Name DPT_SwitchOnMode DPT ID 20.608 Datatype format N8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit Default
Switch On Mode - V : {0-2} - enable
Communication:

 Group Object Datapoint Mandatory:
Default Group Address: --DP Address: object_type: PID:
(in the server) start_index: nr_of_elem:

Property access: Read only Read/Write
Protection Read level - Write level Exception Handling: Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
After initialisation for values 0,2:
The colour actual value in last ON-State or the last received absolute set value may be not known. After
reception of SOO = On with unknown colour temperature, it is implementation specific to recall an colour
value
Special Features:
--

##### 6.7.9 Parameter Colour xyY for Scene Number (XYYSN)

FB: Colour Actuator xyY Property Name (Server): Colour xyY Mandatory
(CAXYY) Switch On Set Optional

Value

Description:
Stored Colour xyY for recalling after receiving the dedicated scene number.
If the field C respectively B has the value “invalid”, then, if the scene configured through this entry is
called, the xy-Colour or respectively the brightness shall not change.
DPT: Name DPT_Colour_xy DPT ID 242.600 Datatype format B8U16U16U8
Y

Field Description Sup. Range Unit Default
C This field shall indicate whether M {0,1} None None.
the colour information in the .
fields x-axis and y-axis is valid
or not.

B This field shall indicate whether M {0,1} None None.
the brightness information in the .
field Brightness is valid or not.

x-axis x-coordinate of the colour M 0-65535 None None.
information .

y-axis y-coordinate of the colour M 0-65535 None None.
information .

Brightness Brightness of the colour M 0 % to 100 % None None.

.

Communication:
DP Address: object_type: PID:
(in the server) start_index: nr_of_elem:

Property access: Read only Read/Write
Protection Read level - Write level Exception Handling: Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
None.
Special Features:
It is allowed to implement the array with less than the given number of 64 elements.
If a scene is learned (DPT_Scene_Control, 18.001), then the FB CAXYY shall always set both fields C
and B to “valid”.
